**New function: `finalizeCollapsibleAssistantMsg(el: HTMLElement): void`**
```
function finalizeCollapsibleAssistantMsg(el: HTMLElement): void {
  const body = el.querySelector(".msg-collapse-body") as HTMLElement | null;
  if (!body) return;
  
  const fullText = body.textContent ?? "";
  
  // Find last double newline
  const lastBreak = fullText.lastIndexOf("\n\n");
  
  if (lastBreak <= 0) {
    // Single paragraph - move everything to conclusion, hide collapsible
    const conclusionDiv = el.querySelector(".msg-collapse-conclusion") as HTMLElement | null;
    if (conclusionDiv) {
      conclusionDiv.textContent = fullText;
      conclusionDiv.classList.remove("hidden");
    }
    // Hide the collapse header and body
    const header = el.querySelector(".msg-collapse-header") as HTMLElement | null;
    if (header) header.style.display = "none";
    body.classList.add("hidden");
    return;
  }
  
  const beforeConclusion = fullText.slice(0, lastBreak);
  const conclusion = fullText.slice(lastBreak + 2);
  
  // Update body
  body.textContent = beforeConclusion;
  
  // Update conclusion div
  let conclusionDiv = el.querySelector(".msg-collapse-conclusion") as HTMLElement | null;
  if (!conclusionDiv) {
    conclusionDiv = el("div", "msg-collapse-conclusion");
    el.appendChild(conclusionDiv);
  }
  conclusionDiv.textContent = conclusion;
  conclusionDiv.classList.remove("hidden");
}
```

```javascript
function getMessageText(message: unknown): string {
    if (!message || typeof message !== "object") return "";
    const m = message as {
        role?: string;
        customType?: string;
        content?: string | Array<{ type: string; text?: string }>;
    };
    if (typeof m.content === "string") return m.content;
    if (Array.isArray(m.content)) {
        return m.content
            .filter((p) => p.type === "text")
            .map((p) => p.text ?? "")
            .join("\n");
    }
    return "";
}
```

### Problem
Assistant text responses in the web UI were placed entirely inside a `.msg-collapse-body.hidden` div, making them invisible on first view. Users had to click to expand before seeing any reply.

### Fix
**`packages/web/src/main.ts`:**
1. **`appendCollapsibleAssistantMsg`** — now adds an empty `.msg-collapse-conclusion` div after the collapsible body. For non-streaming messages, calls `finalizeCollapsibleAssistantMsg` to split text at the last `\n\n` paragraph break.
2. **New `finalizeCollapsibleAssistantMsg`** — extracts the full text from the collapsible body, splits at the last `\n\n`:
   - If there is a split: puts the prefix in the collapsible body (foldable), puts the concluding paragraph in `.msg-collapse-conclusion` (always visible), and sets the header label to "Response".
   - If single paragraph: hides the collapsible header entirely, shows all text in the always-visible conclusion div.
3. **`renderHistory`** — uses `appendCollapsibleAssistantMsg` (which auto-finalizes for non-streaming).
4. **`message_end` handler** — calls `finalizeCollapsibleAssistantMsg` after streaming completes to restructure the DOM.
5. Removed unused `extractConclusion` and `updateCollapsibleAssistantLabel`.

**`packages/web/src/style.css`:**
- Added `.msg.assistant .msg-collapse-conclusion` styling to match the body style but always visible (no `.hidden` class).

### Behavior
- **Collapsed state**: Shows just "Response" header with expand toggle, plus the final concluding paragraph always visible below.
- **Expanded state**: Shows all intermediate text, tool calls (rendered separately), and the conclusion.
- **Single-paragraph responses**: No collapsible wrapper at all — text shown directly.
